image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a tiger beetle (Cicindelinae) positioned on rough, sandy soil next to a piece of dry wood. The beetle exhibits a metallic dark green/bronze exoskeleton with distinct pale cream-colored spots on its elytra. Its head is broad with large compound eyes and visible mandibles. Long, filiform antennae extend forward. Six slender legs are visible, gripping the substrate.

To ensure the thin, complex structures of the legs and antennae do not merge with the background or the body (common AI artifact in insects).
To verify the physical realism of the metallic iridescence and chitinous texture, ensuring it doesn't look like plastic or digital noise.
